title: Game 5: Magnus vs Hans
notes: Game 5 of 20 in the experiment. Magnus (the learner) reads his notebook before every move; Hans (the control) has no notebook.
result_text: Draw: not enough pieces left to checkmate

new_lessons: Before trading queens or simplifying for a "clean" material gain, scan for alternative moves (like Bg5) that win more material or keep attack alive.
When ahead in rook endgames, prioritize keeping rooks active and opponent's king cut off rather than trading rooks to "simplify" when material is already behind.
After each candidate move, explicitly list all enemy pieces attacking the destination square before committing to the capture or trade.
